name: James McGuire

aka: Jas Mcguine (Ancestry PA death cert. index)

bioAdditions: The 1927 Pennsylvania death-certificate index lists "McGuire, James; 54803; W-Barre; May 23" (S1), matching the FamilySearch death date. Six months later his son William Bernard's marriage application described James as dead and born at Danville, Pa. (S2). Danville is the post office of Mahoning Township, Montour County, where Edward McGuire's household, including a son James aged 9, was enumerated in 1870 (S3). That ties Kathryn's grandfather to the Danville furnace family by a record independent of the FamilySearch tree.

conflicts.assessment: Danville (Montour Co.) and Bloomsburg (Columbia Co.) are about 10 miles apart; the family was at Danville in 1870 and the elder sister Mary is given as born at Bloomsburg in the FS tree. Keep Bloomsburg as tree value but record Danville; the 1927 death certificate (#54803) should settle it.

relationships.evidence: Son's 1927 license gives James's birthplace as Danville, home of the 1870 Edward McGuire household that included a James aged 9; FS links them

confidenceRecommendation.justification: Named as father of Frank J. (1923 license) and of William B. (1927 license); death indexed 1927 file 54803 with matching date/place.
